Galawezh (Gelavêj / Galawej) is a Kurdish feminine name, recorded in Kurdish name references as the Kurdish name of a bright star — the constellation Sirius / Canopus (variously reported). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave أحمد (Ahmad) as the Arabic form and labelled it Arabic; the name is Kurdish, not Arabic. The exact astronomical identification varies between sources, so 'bright star (Sirius/Canopus)' is reported with that caveat. No meaning is asserted, because asserting one would require inventing evidence.
